conversion.hierarchy: global(model) = global(parent) * T * Rz * Ry * Rx * S for the recorded fixed transform-property domain; source node and geometry IDs/hierarchy remain in the manifest.

source_transform_domain.axes: UpAxis Y, FrontAxis Z (+), CoordAxis X (+); UnitScaleFactor 1.0
source_transform_domain.transforms: every Model InheritType 1 (RSrs), no pivots/offsets/pre-post rotation/geometric transform, default XYZ order: global = parent * T * Rz * Ry * Rx * S
source_transform_domain.mirroring: 272 geometries are shared by a right (.r) and a left (.l) Model; the left Model has a negative scale (mirror copy)

conversion.operation: p_output = s * R * (W_source_node * p_source) + t; then the producer's four-decimal canonical formatting.
conversion.scale_note: The final recorded similarity already includes the chosen source-to-BodyParts3D relation. Do not add an extra factor of ten or another axis conversion. Physical/anatomical units and calibration remain unvalidated.
conversion.topology: Source polygons were fan-triangulated; source instances with a negative inherited determinant had triangle winding reversed. Unreferenced vertices were removed in sorted source-index order; only repeated-index triangles were dropped.
conversion.rounding: Four decimal places in recorded millimetre coordinates, with negative zero canonicalized to 0.0000. This is serialization precision, not biological accuracy.

recorded_registration_diagnostics.method: step 1: initial axis map (x, y, z)_BP3D = 10 * (X, -Z, Y)_FBX, then point-to-point trimmed ICP (10 % worst pairs trimmed) of Z-Anatomy neck-muscle vertices to the closest SURFACE point of the SAME structure in the BodyParts3D packet, Horn similarity (rotation, translation, one uniform scale) -> register-final-neck_nogenio.json. Step 2 (chosen): point-to-plane similarity ICP from step 1, two equally weighted groups: (a) the same neck pairs, (b) the bone-contact patches (vertices within 3 mm of bone) of 12 face/chewing muscles that lie on bone in the textbook, matched to the BodyParts3D skull bones + mandible; 10 % trimmed per group; 60 iterations (scale steady to +/-0.001 over the last 30). Residuals are exact point-to-triangle distances on every vertex.
recorded_registration_diagnostics.why_these_structures: the only structures present in both the downloaded file and the BodyParts3D packet near the face are neck and floor-of-mouth muscles (sternocleidomastoid, digastric, mylohyoid, geniohyoid); the skull is not in the muscle file and no second download was made for it

diagnostic_scope: These are recorded producer fit/contact/sensitivity diagnostics, including alternatives and rejected correspondences. They were not independently validated or recomputed by the fixed-derivation check. They are not held-out anatomical accuracy, accepted clinical tolerances, proof of historical target-byte consumption or a normal-mechanics model.

fixed_derivation_check.triangle_comparison: Exact ordered index triples, winding convention and counts
fixed_derivation_check.interpretation: Reproduction under the pinned producer interpretation only; no independent decoder, fit accuracy, outward-normal, anatomy/deformation/function/held-out/native/production validation.
fixed_derivation_check.pure_API_change: The original extraction block was exposed as a pure function without changing its derivation. A source inverse check reconstructed the original extractor hash 443f81e224d4e4b7366ec6a34634c71d0151fdf6a789ddb380ff0c99eca93514. The helper hashes used by the fixed check are separate from the recorded original producer-tool hashes.

scientific_limits.geometry: Asset IDs, paths, hashes, vertex/triangle counts, coordinates, topology and numerical registration records are unchanged by this public metadata revision.
scientific_limits.registration: Fit residuals, bone distances and alternative-fit sensitivity are producer-reported diagnostics, not independent held-out accuracy or clinical tolerances.
scientific_limits.anatomy_and_function: Structure names, what_it_does, rig_hint, attachment_bone and bodymap_regions are atlas/illustrative implementation metadata. Their presence does not validate facial deformation, neural mapping or physiological function.
scientific_limits.production: Current anatomical/reference, rendered full-scene, timing, resource-enforcement and production checks remain incomplete.

metadata_revision.change_scope: Explanatory metadata/documentation only; every mesh byte and numerical registration record retained.
metadata_revision.historical_record: The original conversion metadata is identified by its recorded hash. This record retains the source, method, numerical diagnostics, fixed-derivation result and scientific limitations.

recorded_source_retrieval_utc.scope: Times recorded in the original download record; source identity is established by the pinned bytes/blob, not by a new availability check.
